content: “Makalongo bhango na akatate bhango, unyokanikiye ngohe punikikengelela palonge jhino!”
Pibhanyohina akilonge nabho kwa lugha jha Kiebulaniya bhajhakuchocha kubhehe nuu. Peniya Pauli ajhakulonge.

“Nenga Nayahude, jhumelekilwe ku Taliso, ku kilambo cha ku Kilikiya. Nambo nelitwe pambano pano ku Yeluchalemo. Nenga nikibha mmolwa jwa Gamaliele, na nikabholitwe kulikamuu mbone mabholo ghoha gha akahoko bhito. Hengita lihengo kwa mwojho gwango ghoha kwa Chapanga ngita hela mangota chimuhenga deleno.
Nenga nikang'ahite na ata kwakoma bhando bhibhakengama ndela jha Bhambo. Nakakamwile akanalome na akakeghe na kwatabha mukipungo.

Mpiya litambiko Nkolongwa pamonga na udamo ghoha gwa akanahota bhahoto kumanya kwa uchakaka lijhambu lyenio. Kuhumii kwa bheniya nikapokii baluwa jhibhajhandikilwa Akayahude ajhito bhubhatamita ku Damasiko. Nikajhawile ku Damasiko kwakamula bhando bhibhanyeketii Kilichitu na kwaleta ku Yeluchalemo bhahadabulwe.
Pauli ichimulila pannyeketila Yecho
“Pumandikila kuhika ku Damasiko chaa chita jha muhe, papalapala lumule lukolongwa kubhoke kunane kwa Chapanga lujhakuntindila.
Nyakugwegha pahe puu, nyakujhoha lilobhe linobholila, ‘Saule, Saule nhwalo gwa nike ming'aha?’
Na nenga nyakukonya, ‘Mwe ma ghane, Bhambo?’ Jwenio ajhakunyanguu, ‘Nenga ndi Yecho jwa ku Nachalete jhuming'aha naha.’
Bhala ajhango bhakaluwene lumule lola, nambo bhakajhohine lilobhe lya jhola jwalongila na nenga.
Bhahe, nenga ngangonyita, ‘Bhambo, henge nike?’ Na jwenio ajhakujhanguu, ‘Jhema, nnyende ku Damasiko, na kwenio nannobholelwa mambu ghimipalwa kuhenga.’
Nhwalo gwa lumule lola kubhehe ndaa hake, nikahotwi jhe kulola kabhele na peniya ajhango bhala bhajhakundandaha kwa kungamuu lubhoko ade ku muche gwa Damasiko.
“Kola ku Damasiko kukibha na mundo jhumo jwakemitwa Ananiya, mundo jwampalita hake Chapanga, na kukamula lilaghalikilo lito. Na Akayahude bhoha bhatembikiya hake.
Jwenio akahikite kuninga, ajhakujhema pahina na nenga na kunnobholela, ‘Nnongo gwango Saule, nnole kabhele!’ Papalapala nyakuhoto kulola kabhele.
Peniya Ananiya ajhakulonge, ‘Chapanga jwa hoko gwito umanye chakipala jwenio na kumwona jhola ntumiche jwake jwahanganicha Chapanga, na jwanyokanikiya jwenio akilongela.
Chamalongolela bhando mambu ghala ghimaghawene na kughajhoha.
Ngoche milinde nike? Jhema mbatichwe na nnekekewe uhakaho gwino kwa liina lya Bhambo Yecho.’ ”
Kukemwa kwa Pauli kwatangachila bhando bha ilambo henge
“Pumujhita kuhumii ku Yeluchalemo, na punikibha mukujhopa mu Nyumba jha Chapanga, nyakupata uloto.
Nikamwene Bhambo, na jwenio anobholila, ‘Mmoke kajhombe ku Yeluchalemo, nhwalo bhando bhamba nabhajhekete ndeka malobhe ghimulongela panane jhango.’
Na nenga nyakujhanguu, ‘Bhambo, bhando abha bhimanya chakaka nikibha mbetita munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude nakwapunga na kwabula bhando bhala bhibhanyeketila liina lino.
Ntumiche gwino Sitefano pakomitwa, na nenga nikibha papalapala, na nenga nikajheketile mambu ghala. Helahela kulonda ngobho ya bhala bhubhankomita.’
Peniya Bhambo akanobholile, ‘Nnyende, nhwalo chanintuma kutale kwa bhando bha ilambo henge.’ ”

Ade pambano, lilongo lya bhando lilinyokanikiya Pauli akilongela malobhe ghala. Nambo palongila malobhe ghanga bhakalalime hake, “Munkome mundo jwenio! Nhwalo tupala ndeka abhonekane pannema abhii ghome!”
Bhajhakujhendelela kuchobhela chobhela kongo bhanyuhita makote ghabhe na bhauchita lutukunda kunane.

Nkolongwa jwa akakomana ngondo ajhakwalobholela bhando bhake bhampeleke Pauli nkate jha nyumba jha akakomana ngondo. Ajhakwalaghalikiya bhantyale yato na akonywe, nhwalo gwa nike Akayahude bhachobhii kwa nhwalo gwake.
Nambo pubhakibha bhankongite kwa kuntyala, Pauli ajhakunkonya nkolongwa jwa akakomana ngondo jhumo, “Bho, chakaka lilaghalikilo lilongela kutyala mundo jwa ku Loma kabula jha kuhadabulwa?”
Nkolongwa jwa ngondo pajhohina malobhe gheniya, ajhakunyendela munahota gwake na kunkonya, “Bho, mipala kuhenga nike? Bho, mundo jhonjo jwa ku Loma!”
Bhahe, na jwenio munahota nkomana ngondo ajhakunyendela Pauli na kunkonya, “Unobholele chakaka, mwenga ndi mundo jwa ku Loma?” Pauli ajhakujhanguu, “Chakaka.”
Peniya nkolongwa jwa akakomana ngondo ajhakulonge, “Nenga hele jwa ku Loma hemile kwa mbijha yamahele kubhehe mundo jwa ku Loma.” Pauli ajhakunnobholela, “Nenga melekilwe ku Loma.”
Papalapala bhando bhala bhubhapata kuningukiya Pauli bhajhakuhobhelela. Ata nkolongwa jwa akakomana ngondo jhola ajhakujhoghopa akamanyite Pauli mundo jwa ku Loma na akibha akongitwe minyololo.
Pauli palonge jha udamo gwa Akayahude

Kilabho jhake, akakomana ngondo akapahile kumanya matakalilo gha Akayahude panane jha Pauli. Bhahe, ajhakumopola Pauli minyololo jhela, na kwalobholela bhakolo bha akapiya matambiko pamonga na udamo ghoha bhakongane. Peniya ajhakuneta Pauli na ajhakunyemeka palonge jha udamo.
